activation: Main only, after current serial checkpoint/readout and all-eight safe boundary; never mid-sleep
boundary_contract: run max_steps and lease callback must agree on all ranks; failed collective poisons segment; no publish or retry without explicit recovery
checkpoint_contract: Collective checkpoint: only rank0 gets CPU payload containing LoRA, same optimizer state, cursor, schema/binding, eight RNG states. Caller atomically saves before publication.

checkpoint_serializer_adapter.commit: Caller atomically binds adapter, original-format owner optimizer/RNG, all-rank sidecar and source/recipe hashes. Publish only a completed sleep; never a partially reduced/half-applied step.
checkpoint_serializer_adapter.failure: A failed backend refuses further run/checkpoint until explicit restore. Do not silently restart or regenerate charged captures. Reserve deadline time for bounded segment checkpointing and FINAL.
checkpoint_serializer_adapter.owner_compatibility: Store rank0 optimizer and rank0 cpu/cuda RNG in existing owner format; save the complete parallel payload as a separately hashed native sidecar. Do not discard seven worker RNG states.

comparison: Average-gradient batch8 AdamW, not serial-equivalent; partial tail divides by active ranks, no padding

counter_adapter.comparison: Serial exposures identical, AdamW trajectory explicitly different.
counter_adapter.optimizer_steps: Add actual logical AdamW steps (236 for measured frozen1884-row schedule), not serial presentation count. Existing global optimizer steps persist.
counter_adapter.tail: Four active ranks in final measured batch; other four perform no forward/backward but join CPU collectives. No padding/repeats/drops.
counter_adapter.weights: Each active rank mean child loss*.75 plus mean anchor loss*.25, then average active-rank gradients before one F1 step.

model_contract: Existing enabled fp32 LoRA; frozen base; no DDP/reducing hooks or readonly decoder wrapper
optimizer_contract: Exactly rank0 existing AdamW owns exactly those same LoRA parameter objects; workers None
required_boundary: Current serial sleep finishes normally; preserve checkpoint, optimizer steps, readouts and every charged capture.
Main chooses a future generation after all-eight safe handoff; unchanged commonCONFIG/leases/FINAL scheduler.
Caller supplies same common-checkpoint adapter on every existing raw engine, preserving parameter objects and F1 existing AdamW reference.
Caller owns finite-timeout Gloo group; never fork already-loaded CUDA engines. All ranks invoke constructor/run/checkpoint/restore in lockstep.
Validate new-source frozen closure and manifest before activation; current CPU readiness is not authorization to alter current sleep.
restore_contract: Collective restore(owner_payload on rank0, None elsewhere), in-place copy, existing optimizer object and all rank RNG; no automatic recovery/replay
row_adapter: prepare_native_cohort: verify native captures, same replay encoder and exact42 BASE inventory; retain encoding rejections
usable_call_sequence: prepared = parallel.prepare_native_cohort(shared=pinned_shared, anchor_module=pinned_anchors, root=common_root, tokenizer=raw_engine.tokenizer, anchors=actual_F1_anchor_order, anchor_root=anchor_root, expected_config_sha256=config_sha, expected_state_sha256=state_sha, source_files=frozen_source_files)
backend = parallel.ParallelSleep(raw_engine, existing_F1_AdamW if group_rank == 0 else None, group=gloo_group, **arguments)
